item.title: Missing canoer recovered from East Haddam lake 2 days after boat capsized
item.description: A missing canoer has been recovered in Lake Hayward two days after the boat capsized, officials said. The Department of Energy and Environmental Protection (DEEP) announced Monday that crews have recovered the body of 20-year-old Dominick Tocci of Woodstock. Tocci was on the boat along with another man in his 20s when it capsized just before 10 p.m. on Saturday….

item.title: Fudd's 34 points, 8 3-pointers powers UConn past Syracuse and into Sweet 16 for 32nd straight time
item.description: Azzi Fudd scored 26 of her 34 points in the first half in her final game at Gampel Pavilion and UConn used a 31-0 run to roll to a 98-45 win over Syracuse to advance to the NCAA Tournament’s Sweet 16 for the 32nd season in a row. Fudd’s eight 3-pointers were one short of the NCAA Tournament single-game record. Sarah Strong had 18 points and seven rebounds as UConn won its 52nd consecutive game. item.title: Rollover crash closes part of I-84 East in Willington during morning commute
item.description: A rollover crash on I-84 East closed the right lane of the highway between Exits 71 and 72 in Willington. A double tractor-trailer crashed and completely overturned onto its back just before midnight on Monday, and the right lane was closed until around 9 a.m. Tuesday.
